newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude CFO to leave, seeks new president.
newsitem.headline: St. Jude CFO to leave, seeks new president.

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc said early Friday morning that its chief financial officer plans to leave the company by the end of the month, and that it is searching for a president and chief operating officer.

Chief Financial Officer Stephen Wilson is leaving to become executive vice president and CFO of Computer Motion Inc, a Goleta, Calif.-based supplier of advanced robotic devices for medical applications.

Terry Shepherd, who is president of St. Jude Medical's heart valve division, will serve as acting chief financial officer. The company said it is seeking a replacement for Wilson, who had been CFO since 1990.
St. Jude, which develops, manufactures and distributes medical devices for the cardiovascular market, said it also is looking to recruit a president and chief operating officer.
The company did not immediately return a telephone call.

St. Jude Chairman, Chief Executive and President Ronald Matricaria said in a statement that the board of directors "has concluded it is an appropriate time to recruit a president for the company, given the substantial increase in the scale of St. Jude Medical and our expanding global operations."
